_note: Seasonfall authored region content for Frostaris. Read-only at runtime: nothing in this file changes during play. Runtime state (god resolutions, kill counts, stillness progress, current settlement ratings) lives in a save file — see world_state.new_save. Settlement stability/prosperity here are base (start-of-game) values. Settlement names, ratings and degraded states are [PROPOSED] placeholders. Structure follows CF 001 (resolution enum), CF 003 (gods_resolved, eclipse_armed), CF 004 (stillness as adjacency graph, settlement vintage, anchor quality).
_anchor_note: CF 004 rules two heartland, two marginal. Which two is blocked on the underlayer. Placeholder.

rating_scale._note: GB 13.3 defines no ranges anywhere in the corpus. 0-100 int is [PROPOSED] and needs a ruling before authoring spreads.

vaerholt.siting_note: Walled deepwater port. The sea has been ice for nine centuries. The harbour cranes still stand.

degraded_state.text: The cranes stop mid-swing. Nobody remembers ordering the work halted, and nobody restarts it.

stonecross.siting_note: Built where the road met the ford. The ford is glass. The road still runs.

degraded_state.text: The market keeps its hours. No one has brought anything to sell for two seasons.

uphearth.siting_note: Founded by the fled. Sited for distance, not soil. Terraced gravel, three months of growing weather.

degraded_state.text: They planted anyway. The seed sits in the ground exactly as it was set down.

greyfold.siting_note: Border post at the lucid edge. Mixed population. Two grievances sharing one wall.

degraded_state.text: The argument that has run here for four generations stops mid-sentence and is not resumed.

stillhaven.siting_note: Held by the line that stayed. Sited by proximity as the point. Nothing here registers what it costs.

degraded_state.text: Nothing changes. That was always the arrangement. The difference is that now it is true.
